title: Sparkly maple leaf
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <g>
    <!-- stem -->
    <path d="M50 86 L50 70" stroke="#8a5a1f" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <!-- leaf main shape (simple maple) -->
    <path d="M50 70
             L38 64 L30 52 L34 52 L26 40 L34 42 L32 32 L42 40 L44 30 L50 38
             L56 30 L58 40 L68 32 L66 42 L74 40 L66 52 L70 52 L62 64 Z"
          fill="#e8522a"/>
    <!-- lighter inner shade to give definition -->
    <path d="M50 66
             L41 61 L35 52 L38 52 L33 44 L38 45 L37 38 L43 43 L45 36 L50 41
             L55 36 L57 43 L63 38 L62 45 L67 44 L62 52 L65 52 L59 61 Z"
          fill="#f47a3e"/>
    <!-- veins -->
    <path d="M50 62 L50 44 M50 52 L42 46 M50 52 L58 46 M50 58 L44 54 M50 58 L56 54"
          stroke="#ffb27a" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none"/>
    <!-- sparkles -->
    <g fill="#ffe66b">
      <!-- big sparkle top left -->
      <path d="M20 22 L22 28 L28 30 L22 32 L20 38 L18 32 L12 30 L18 28 Z"/>
      <!-- big sparkle top right -->
      <path d="M80 18 L82 24 L88 26 L82 28 L80 34 L78 28 L72 26 L78 24 Z"/>
      <!-- small sparkle left -->
      <path d="M14 55 L15.5 58 L18.5 59 L15.5 60 L14 63 L12.5 60 L9.5 59 L12.5 58 Z"/>
      <!-- small sparkle right -->
      <path d="M86 50 L87.5 53 L90.5 54 L87.5 55 L86 58 L84.5 55 L81.5 54 L84.5 53 Z"/>
      <!-- tiny sparkle bottom left -->
      <path d="M26 76 L27 78 L29 79 L27 80 L26 82 L25 80 L23 79 L25 78 Z"/>
      <!-- tiny sparkle bottom right -->
      <path d="M76 74 L77 76 L79 77 L77 78 L76 80 L75 78 L73 77 L75 76 Z"/>
    </g>
    <g fill="#a8e0ff">
      <!-- little blue sprinkles -->
      <circle cx="34" cy="20" r="1.8"/>
      <circle cx="66" cy="16" r="1.8"/>
      <circle cx="18" cy="44" r="1.5"/>
      <circle cx="84" cy="40" r="1.5"/>
      <circle cx="40" cy="82" r="1.5"/>
      <circle cx="62" cy="84" r="1.5"/>
    </g>
  </g>
</svg>
